name: Bel Fuse Inc.
summary: Bel Fuse Inc. designs, manufactures, markets, and sells products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates in three product groups: Power Solutions and Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The company's products are used in the networking, telecommunications, computing, general industrial, high-speed data transmission, defence, commercial aerospace, transportation, and e-Mobility industries.
